sub: Fixed public IPs and instance placement control.

Overview.p: An Elastic IP is a static public IPv4 address you keep until you release it. Placement groups control how instances sit on hardware: Cluster, Spread or Partition.
Elastic IP = a permanent phone number you can move to another phone. Placement group = choosing whether your servers sit close together or far apart.
A company keeps one Elastic IP on its main server so the address never changes. A big data cluster uses a Cluster placement group for fast networking.
